exercises.name: Breathing & imprint
exercises.description: Lie supine, knees bent. Inhale wide into ribs; exhale and gently imprint lower back toward the mat.

exercises.name: Dead bug prep
exercises.description: Arms to ceiling, knees at table-top. Alternate lowering opposite arm and leg with control.

exercises.name: Single-leg stretch
exercises.description: Head and shoulders lifted if comfortable. Pull one knee in, extend the other leg long at hip height.

exercises.name: Bridge articulation
exercises.description: Peel spine up vertebra by vertebra, then roll down with control. Keep knees aligned over ankles.

exercises.name: Side-lying clams
exercises.description: Stack hips and shoulders. Open top knee without rolling the pelvis backward.

exercises.name: Plank hold
exercises.description: Shoulders over wrists, long line from head to heels. Breathe steadily; soften grip on the floor.

exercises.name: Forearm plank rocks
exercises.description: Minimal shift forward and back from forearms. Keep ribs knitted, hips level.

exercises.name: Spine stretch forward
exercises.description: Seated, legs hip-width. Round forward from head, articulating through the spine.

exercises.name: Swimming prep
exercises.description: Prone, arms long. Lift chest slightly; alternate small arm and leg reaches.

exercises.name: Side plank (modified)
exercises.description: Forearm or hand support, hips stacked. Hold or add a controlled hip lift.

exercises.name: Roll-down to half roll-back
exercises.description: Seated tall. Nod chin, peel back to mid-back, then return with breath.

exercises.name: Cat–cow
exercises.description: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips. Flex and extend the spine slowly.

exercises.name: Child’s pose variation
exercises.description: Knees wide, arms forward or alongside. Breathe into upper back expansion.

exercises.name: Figure-four stretch
exercises.description: Supine, ankle over opposite knee. Draw thigh gently toward you for glute/hip release.

exercises.name: Supine twist
exercises.description: Knees together, drop to one side; switch. Keep shoulders grounded if possible.
